## Text to Image (SenseNova U1.5)

**Input Assets**
- none — this template starts from text.

One English caption in, one image out. U1.5 ships as a single 8B checkpoint: `Checkpoint Loader` returns MODEL, CLIP and VAE together, so there is no separate text encoder or VAE to pick.

1. **Checkpoint Loader** — `SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-BF16-T8.safetensors` from `models/checkpoints/`.
2. **SenseNova Sampling Options** — `shift` 3.0, the official default.
3. **CLIP Text Encode** — your caption; leave the negative empty, it encodes the unconditional prompt.
4. **Empty HiDream O1 Latent Image** — pixel space, so width/height are the final pixel size.
5. **KSampler** — 50 steps, CFG 4, `euler` / `normal`, denoise 1: the upstream reference settings.

Write captions the way the model was trained: one sentence, comma-separated attributes, medium last, and quote verbatim any text you want rendered. For dense layouts (posters, infographics) upstream suggests running the brief through its Image PE first — see the cookbook link in the next note.

**Faster runs**: `Lora Loader Model Only` + `SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-LoRA-8step-ComfyUI.safetensors` (strength 1), then 8 steps and CFG 1.

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face: t8star/SenseNova-U1.5-Comfy](https://huggingface.co/t8star/SenseNova-U1.5-Comfy) — ComfyUI single-file weights
- [Official weights: sensenova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT](https://huggingface.co/sensenova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT)
- [Cookbook: prompt style, Image PE, editing recipes](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1/blob/feat/u1.5/docs/u1.5_best_practices.md)

**checkpoints**
- [SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-BF16-T8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/t8star/SenseNova-U1.5-Comfy/resolve/main/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-BF16-T8.safetensors) — 35 GB

**loras**
- [SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-LoRA-8step-ComfyUI.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/t8star/SenseNova-U1.5-Comfy/resolve/main/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-LoRA-8step-ComfyUI.safetensors) — 815 MB

## Model Storage Location

```
ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-BF16-T8.safetensors
ComfyUI/models/loras/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-LoRA-8step-ComfyUI.safetensors
```

## Sizes

Official buckets, safe as-is: `2048x2048` (1:1, default), `2720x1536` (16:9), `1536x2720` (9:16), `2496x1664` (3:2), `1664x2496` (2:3), plus 4:3 (2368x1760), 3:4, 2:1 (2880x1440), 1:2, 3:1 (3456x1152) and 1:3 at their own sizes (full list in the cookbook link above).

Other sizes work — multiples of 32 — but fall outside the trained set. Batch > 1 multiplies VRAM; keep 2048x2048 at batch 1.
